authLayout.slogan: Stop making your customers wait in line
authLayout.description: The auth surface keeps the same operational clarity and product trust as the rest of the ticketing system.
authLayout.statTrustMeta: Brand and security steps share the same interface language.
authLayout.statSpeedMeta: Email, social, and recovery flows follow one pattern.
authLayout.statCoverageMeta: The sign-in flow reads like part of the product, not a detached screen.
authLayout.panelTitle: One screen, one step, one decision
authLayout.panelDescription: Each auth screen emphasizes a single action while secondary information stays quieter, so the next step is always obvious.

badRequest.title: Review the request and try again
badRequest.description: The link or request format is not valid, so PERFO could not open this screen. Return home and re-enter through a normal product flow.

unauthorized.title: This screen requires sign-in
unauthorized.description: You need an authenticated session to continue here. Sign in first and you can return to the flow you were on.

forbidden.title: This account cannot access the page
forbidden.description: Your current account does not have permission for this area. Try another account if you manage this resource through a different workspace.

notFound.title: We could not find that screen
notFound.description: The address may have changed or the page is no longer available. Return to PERFO and continue from the current ticket flow.

server.title: Something went wrong while loading the screen
server.description: PERFO could not complete this request because of a temporary issue. Try again shortly or return home.
